hero_subhead: Professional garden maintenance and landscaping in Liverpool. From routine upkeep to complete garden transformations, we handle it all.
services_subhead: Whether your garden needs a tidy-up or a complete overhaul, we offer tailored services to suit every budget and vision.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Upkeep
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, and seasonal borders keep your garden looking fresh year-round. We work to a schedule that suits you.

services.title: Landscaping & Design
services.desc: Transform your outdoor space with bespoke landscaping. Patios, raised beds, pathways, and planting schemes designed to your taste.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of patios and decking that creates an outdoor living space perfect for entertaining and relaxation.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Safe, professional tree felling, crown reduction, and pruning to maintain health and safety in your garden.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Waste Removal
services.desc: Reclaim your space with full garden clearance, including debris removal and responsible recycling or disposal.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Borders
services.desc: Colour and structure all year. We plan and plant seasonal flowers, shrubs, and perennials that thrive in Liverpool's climate.

about_pullquote: A beautiful garden transforms how you live. That's what we build for our neighbours.
about_para_1: Bellissimo Garden Services was founded on a simple idea: every garden tells a story, and every homeowner deserves one they're proud of. With over 15 years' experience in Liverpool and the North West, we've helped hundreds of families reclaim, redesign, and maintain the outdoor spaces they love. From intimate courtyards to sprawling suburban gardens, our local knowledge and hands-on approach mean your garden gets the care it needs.
about_para_2: We're not a faceless franchise — we're your neighbours, and we treat every garden as if it's our own. Word-of-mouth and repeat customers form the backbone of our business, because when you do good work fairly and listen to what people want, they come back. Whether you need a one-off overhaul or ongoing maintenance, we're here to help your garden thrive.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Bellissimo

reviews.text: We had an overgrown nightmare of a back garden when we moved in. The lads came round, did a full consultation, and gave us a plan we could actually afford. Six weeks later it's like a different house. They were tidy, professional, and actually listened to what we wanted. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Tony and the team have been maintaining our garden every month for three years now. They know exactly what we like, they're always on time, and the price has never crept up. Simple things, but they make all the difference. That's why we stick with them.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Wanted a new patio laying and some raised beds for growing veg. They showed us options, did the work in two days, and left the site spotless. Not the cheapest quote we got, but honestly worth every penny. You can tell they take pride in what they do.
reviews.author: David L.
